director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Cricket ground ke kinaare-kinaare chalkar wahin lauto jahan se chale. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain. Ungli ek kone se har bhuja par chalakar wapas usi kone par lao. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Board par triangle ki har bhuja par uska naap likha hai. Ungli jin bhujaon se guzri, un sabke naap milakar socho. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Haan, Hindi mein batati hoon. Socho is triangle ka kinaara ek dhaage se bana hai. Ek kone se dhaaga khol ke seedha kar do: 4 cm, phir 5 cm, phir 6 cm, sab ek line mein. Us seedhi line ki poori lambai hi parimap hai. Is triangle ke poore kinaare ki lambai kitne centimetre hai?
director.card: Is triangle ke poore kinaare ki lambai kitne centimetre hai?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 15 cm

Sahi jawab, kyunki 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare mein aati hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: pata nahi

Ungli ko hexagon ke kinaare par ek poora chakkar ghumao, aur har bhuja par uski lambai jodte jao. Is hexagon ki chhahon bhujayein barabar hain, aur ek par 5 cm likha hai; poore hexagon ka parimap kitne cm hai?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: thirty

Haan, sahi hai. 6 bhujayein, har ek 5 cm: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: pehle 6, phir bagal ki bhuja 4, phir 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 20 cm

Bilkul sahi: dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Phoolon ki kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m. Kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni baad bachegi, yeh jaanne se pehle kya nikaalna hoga?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao

Baayein taraf maali ke paas ki poori baad hai, daayein taraf kyari ki teeno bhujayein, jin par baad lagegi. Kyari ki bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m hain, aur maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Bachi baad jaanne se pehle kya nikaalna hoga?
pata nahi
Socho, jeb mein 35 rupaye hain aur ek kitaab khareedni hai: kitne bachenge, yeh kitaab ka daam jaane bina pata nahi chalta. Yahan kitaab ki jagah kyari hai. Ab tum batao.
haan
Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
pata nahi, aap batao

Pehle dekhna hai ki kyari ke poore kinaare par kitni baad lagegi, yaani kyari ka parimap. Baad kinaare par hi lagti hai. Parimap mil jaaye, toh use maali ke paas wali baad mein se ghatayenge; jo bache, wahi jawab hai. Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?
director.card: Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Pehle kyari ki bhujaon se uska parimap nikalo, phir dekho 35 m mein se kitni baad bachi. Chalo, ab tumhari baari.

Haan, pehle tum try karo.

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Iska jawab hai maali ke paas 4 m baad bachegi, kyunki 35 m mein se 31 m baad kyari ke kinaare par lag gayi. Yahan tak theek hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka

Sahi jawab. Chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

Haan, sahi hai: kinaare mein do lambai aur do chaudai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
mujhe nahi pata
Parimap kinaare ki saari bhujaon ka jod hai, andar ki jagah ka nahi. Ab dekhenge ki kuch shapes mein itna saara jodna bhi nahi padta. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan

Is rectangle ki do lambi bhujayein 10 m ki hain, woh lambai hai. Do chhoti bhujayein 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

Shuru wala kona do bhujayein door hai. Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?

Sahi jawab, kyunki do lambai aur do chaudai: 19 + 8 + 19 + 8 = 54 m. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. 10 m lambe, 6 m chaude is rectangle ka ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai. 10 do baar, 6 bhi do baar: 32 m. Ek aur rectangle: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Upar baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m neeche. Ab tum saamne wale kone par ho: aadha chakkar. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?
director.card: Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

director.text: 17 m sahi nahi hai. 17 m par tum sirf saamne wale kone tak pahunche ho; shuru wale kone tak lautne mein utna hi raasta aur lagta hai. Lambai 12 m, chaudai 5 m: 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna?
director.card: Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

director.text: Nahi, 17 m theek nahi. Formula mein bracket pehle: usmein lambai aur chaudai jaati hain. Phir bracket ka do guna. Ab tum batao.

director.text: 17 m se baat nahi bani. Is rectangle ki chaar bhujaon ko do jodiyon mein baanto: ek 12 m aur ek 5 m ki jodi, aur waisi hi doosri jodi. Ek jodi ka jod lo aur uska do guna karo: yahi 2 × (lambai + chaudai) hai. Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

director.text: chauntis

Sahi jawab, kyunki aadha chakkar 17 m, do guna 34 m. Ab ek square lo: uski chaaron bhujayein barabar hoti hain, yahan har ek 6 cm. 6 ko chaar baar jodne se achha, seedha 4 × bhuja. Parimap ek doori hai, toh jawab centimetre mein aayega, square centimetre mein nahi. Is square ka parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Is square ka parimap kitna hai?

director.text: 24 cm

Haan, sahi hai: chaar bhujayein, har ek 6 cm: 4 × 6 = 24 cm, parimap ek doori hai isliye cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Ek notebook ka cover rectangle hai, 24 cm lamba aur 18 cm chauda. Uske kinaare par ek baar tape lagani hai. Poore kinaare ki tape ke liye pehle 24 aur 18 ke saath kya karoge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
